column3: A written, formal word: a pet or any dog in speech is 狗, and 犬 lives on in set words such as 警犬. It began as a picture of a dog seen from the side.
column4: 警犬帮助警察找到了失踪的人。
column5: 警犬幫助警察找到了失蹤的人。
column6: Jǐng quǎn bāngzhù jǐngchá zhǎodào le shīzōng de rén.
column7: The police dog helped the police find the missing person.
